title: Build planner
intro: Before the event: how many switches each seat block needs, which port each seat gets, VLANs and management IPs. Then the switch configs and cable labels.
spareHelp: Kept free for staff, a stream PC or a swap.
noBlocks: There are no seat blocks yet. Draw the hall in the floor plan editor first.
apply_one: Add {{count}} switch to the floor plan
apply_other: Add {{count}} switches to the floor plan
applyQuestion: Add them next to their seat blocks as planned switches?
added_other: Added {{count}} switches to the floor plan: {{names}}.
addedNone: Every switch in the plan is on the floor plan already.
modelsHelp: Each model has a config template (Jinja) and the names of its ports. Copy a built-in one to change it.
templateHelp: Jinja. You get switch (name, mgmt_ip, vlans, ports, spare, uplinks), mgmt (vlan, netmask, prefix, gateway), vlans and event.
